propositions: The Verified workflow fans out 6 concurrent jobs (5 per-extra + union) across a 20-slot org limit, causing queuing and extending a ~21m run to 41-47m.

The current matrix covers {agents, eval, tracing, mcp, grounding} but _optional.EXTRAS is {agents, eval, grounding, metrics, tracing}, leaving metrics without per-extra CI and including mcp which has no detection probe.
The refactor collapses per-extra and union jobs into one venv-loop job running 7 iterations (6 isolation extras plus 1 union), reducing concurrent slots and covering metrics.
The loop must use absolute venv paths (never source activate), guard iterations with rc accumulator and continue, and never run bare console scripts, to prevent silent failures and PATH ambiguity.
The loop must assert _optional.extra_installed() for each extra in _optional.EXTRAS and run rebar-mcp --help only in the mcp iteration.

Checked-in test guards must verify the loop contains exit $rc and continue, contains no activate, and covers all _optional.EXTRAS keys; infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json must be updated to remove obsolete check names.
